'''''Allium subvillosum''''', the '''spring garlic''', is a European and North African species of [[wild onion]] native to southern [[Iberia]], the [[Balearic Islands]], Sicily, northern Africa (Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, and the [[Azores]]<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=allium+subvillosum Altervista Flora Italiana, Aglio subvilloso, ''Allium subvillosum'']</ref><ref>Maire, René Charles Joseph Ernest. 1935. Bulletin de la Société d'Histoire Naturelle de l'Afrique du Nord 26: 121. ''Allium album'' var. ''purpurascens''</ref><ref>Viviani, Domenico. 1824. Flora Libycae Specimen 19, ''Allium chamaemoly''</ref><ref>Maire, Réné Charles Joseph Ernest. 1926. Bulletin de la Société d'Histoire Naturelle de l'Afrique du Nord. Algiers xvii. 124, hybr., ''Allium humbertii''</ref><ref>[http://www.botanicus.org/page/1311816 Regel, Eduard August von. 1875. Trudy Imperatorskago S.-Peterburgskago Botaničeskago Sada 3(2): 249. ''Allium subhirsutum'' var. ''canariense'']</ref><ref>Bonnet, Edmond & Barratte, Jean François Gustave 1896. Exploration Scientifique de la Tunisie. Catalogue Raisonné des Plantes Vasculaires de la Tunisie 414, ''Allium subhirsutum'' var. ''vernale''</ref><ref>[http://floressilvestresdelmediterraneo.blogspot.com/2013/01/liliaceae-allium-subvillosum.html Flores Silvestres del Mediterráneo, ''Allium subvillosum'']</ref> where it might be introduced.<ref>{{cite web |title=Allium subvillosum Salzm. ex Schult. & Schult.f. |url=https://acores.flora-on.pt/#/1allium+subvillosum |publisher=[[Flora-On]] |access-date=12 February 2022}}</ref>

''Allium subvillosum'' is a bulb-forming perennial up to 30 cm tall. Leaves are long and narrow, with long white hairs clearly visible to the naked eye. [[Umbel]] is [[hemispherical]], with 15-20 flowers on long [[Pedicel (botany)|pedicels]]. Flowers are white with yellow [[anthers]].<ref>[http://www.botanicus.org/page/736331 Josef August Schultes & Julius Hermann Schultes. 1830. Systema Vegetabilium 7(2): 1104.]</ref><ref>[http://www.botanicus.org/page/223184 Ball, John. 1879. Journal of the Linnean Society, Botany 16: 691]</ref>

;formerly included<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=341363 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>
''Allium subvillosum'' var. ''clusianum'', now called ''[[Allium subhirsutum]]''
